listeners.why: One window, and no second process to sync with: each member here records the callback FreeTube hands it and never fires it.

noop.why: Setters for state this port does not keep. There is no second process whose copy could disagree, and each one's getter beside it answers the same constant every time.

isWaylandPlatform.why: process.platform compiles to the literal undefined for a web build (_scripts/webpack.web.config.js's DefinePlugin), so GeneralSettings.vue's `process.platform === 'linux'` guard around the one call site never evaluates true. false either way.

getReplaceHttpCache.why: The HTTP cache is the browser's here, and this port never replaces it.

getDisableHardwareAcceleration.why: Hardware acceleration is the shell's decision, not the app's.

openInExternalPlayer.why: Launching another program is a power Orivon does not have. Reached only from a user action FreeTube's own chrome offers, never during page mount.

relaunch.why: There is one window and the browser owns its lifetime. Reached only after a setting that asks for a restart.

openInNewWindow.why: Windows and tabs are the browser's. Reached only from a shift-clicked link.

enableProxy.why: A proxy applies to the browser, not to one app inside it. Reached only from the proxy settings screen.

disableProxy.why: The other half of enableProxy, and refused for the same reason.
